contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, bakery and shop windows, canvas awnings, utility poles and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The newspaper is a scene prop, not a product; it covers part of the camel coat sleeve and front, which are conservatively reconstructed with the back. The navy knit shows between the lapels and at the cuff. Black socks show above the black penny loafers. The black crossbody is seen from one side; its far side and full strap length are inferred. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual view_image review of all five look overview sheets; all 28 isolated products, complete pairs and straps, no outfit collages or props; clean final composites on four backgrounds.

deck.ko: 카멜 코트 아래 네이비와 스톤의 차분한 대비.
deck.en: Camel, navy and stone form a quiet contrast.
deck.de: Kamel, Marine und Stein bilden einen ruhigen Kontrast.

intro.ko: 갑자기 펼쳐진 신문 모서리를 잡으며 몸이 앞으로 기울어집니다.
intro.en: A sudden gust opens the paper and draws his body forward to catch its corner.
intro.de: Eine Böe öffnet die Zeitung und zieht den Körper beim Greifen der Ecke nach vorn.

body.ko: 긴 카멜 코트의 라펠 사이로 네이비 니트가 보입니다. 밝은 스톤 바지는 검정 양말과 페니 로퍼로 이어지고 작은 크로스백은 몸 옆에 붙습니다. 흐린 거리의 직광 플래시는 코트 표면과 흔들리는 종이의 접힌 선을 또렷하게 나눕니다.
body.en: Navy knit shows between the long camel coat lapels. Pale stone trousers lead to black socks and penny loafers, while a small crossbody stays close to the side. Direct flash separates the coat surface from the moving folds of paper against the overcast street.
body.de: Marineblauer Strick zeigt sich zwischen den langen kamelfarbenen Revers. Helle steingraue Hosen führen zu schwarzen Socken und Pennyloafern; eine kleine Umhängetasche bleibt seitlich am Körper. Direkter Blitz trennt die Manteloberfläche von den bewegten Papierfalten vor der bedeckten Straße.

pull.ko: 밝은 바지로 이어지는 긴 코트 선.
pull.en: A long coat line meets pale trousers.
pull.de: Eine lange Mantellinie trifft auf helle Hosen.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A long coat line meets pale trousers.

tip.ko: 가방을 옆으로 두고 코트 앞을 열어 두 손의 움직임을 편하게 하세요.
tip.en: Keep the bag at the side and the coat open for free movement of both hands.
tip.de: Die Tasche seitlich und den Mantel offen halten, damit beide Hände frei bleiben.
